mapper.select: select user_id, quota_balance, frozen_quota, used_quota, create_time, update_time from user_quota_account where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.update: update user_quota_account set quota_balance = quota_balance + #{amount}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update user_quota_account set quota_balance = quota_balance - #{amount}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
